rounds.name: Continuity
newThisEra: Publication Dossiers and deterministic claim resolution

actions.name: Fund
actions.summary: Gain 2 Runway, or gain 4 Runway and add 2 Scrutiny.
actions.flavorText: Convert forecasts, access, and urgency into the institutional capacity to continue.

actions.name: Research
actions.summary: Spend 1 Compute to conduct a push-your-luck Training Run.
actions.slogan: A provisional result becomes evidence when the institution says it holds.
actions.flavorText: Train on distinct records of civilization, then decide when a capability claim has become evidence.

actions.name: Build
actions.slogan: A planned future requires sites, power, permits, and maintenance.
actions.flavorText: Turn a declared future into facilities, generators, and regional dependencies.

actions.name: Organize
actions.summary: Recruit, redistribute Teams, or relocate a Facility.
actions.slogan: Every successful transition begins with a revised operating model.
actions.flavorText: Move people, sites, and responsibilities to match the new operating model while presenting each loss of role as a successful transition.

actions.name: Deploy
actions.summary: Spend 1 Compute to gain a Customer if Capability permits.
actions.slogan: A service becomes real when other people must plan around it.
actions.flavorText: Turn demonstrated capability into a service that people, markets, and institutions begin to depend on.

actions.name: Influence
actions.summary: Use political presence to gain Trust, remove Scrutiny, or negotiate from a Facility.
actions.slogan: Institutional permission must be renewed where it is visible.
actions.flavorText: Build the permission, alliances, and official legitimacy required for your preferred future to proceed.

runway.name: Runway
runway.microcopy: Time, capital, and permission to continue.

customers.name: Customers
customers.microcopy: People and institutions that now require the service.

trust.name: Trust
trust.microcopy: Public standing to continue at scale.

researchProtection.name: Research Protection
researchProtection.microcopy: One protected duplicate per Era; Orisonix receives two.

geometry.placementRule: Shuffle each ring pool independently. Frontier remains fixed at center.

startingGridConnection.restrictions: Cannot supply Mega-Cluster demand and cannot be sold.

tiles.name: Frontier
tiles.visit: After Act, you may gain 1 Runway and add 1 Scrutiny.
tiles.flavorText: The jurisdiction’s standing civic exception: new systems are authorized as temporary, beneficial, and voluntary before society must organize around them.

tiles.name: Research Commons
tiles.visit: Gain one additional Research Protection for this Training Run.
tiles.flavorText: Publicly chartered inquiry remains nominally shared while institutions compete to privatize its results, standards, and future uses.

tiles.name: Compute Estate
tiles.visit: Reduce the first Compute cost by 1.
tiles.flavorText: Cooling plant, water compact, and model contract now arrive as one planning application.

tiles.name: Human Access District
tiles.flavorText: Every resident may opt out through the account settings of the service they require.

tiles.name: Fabrication Corridor
tiles.flavorText: Yield, water, labor, and export priority are negotiated at the same loading gate.

tiles.name: Allocation Exchange
tiles.flavorText: Future capacity is priced before the people who will depend on it are asked.

tiles.name: Workforce Transition District
tiles.flavorText: Every transition program includes an exit path for the work it was created to preserve.

tiles.name: Consensus Network
tiles.flavorText: A public is assembled from attention, verification, and the version of events that arrives on time.

tiles.name: Civic Permission Authority
tiles.flavorText: A temporary authorization remains voluntary until every essential service requires it.

tiles.name: Power Corridor
tiles.visit: Build Emergency Power Complex here for 1 Runway. Capacity: 4 local Power. Add 1 Scrutiny each Production it operates. One ordinary Generator per player.
tiles.flavorText: Every promised future submits one more request for transmission, cooling, and priority.

tiles.name: Thermal and Water Basin
tiles.visit: Build Civic Heat Battery here for 2 Runway. Capacity: 3 local Power. Gain 1 Trust when constructed. No recurring penalty. One ordinary Generator per player.
tiles.flavorText: Clean power, water, and thermal relief become one indivisible public ledger.

cards.name: Code
cards.rulesText: First Code this run: add 1 provisional Capability. A later Code is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: Operational records, software practice, and every abstraction that survived deployment.

cards.name: Science
cards.rulesText: First Science this run: add 1 provisional Capability. A later Science is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: Replicated findings, disputed methods, and research that can still be made legible.

cards.name: The Web
cards.rulesText: First Web this run: add 1 provisional Capability. A later Web is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: A public archive of knowledge, commerce, argument, and ungoverned dependence.

cards.name: Books
cards.rulesText: First Books this run: add 1 provisional Capability. A later Books is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: Recorded human thought converted into a licensing and access question.

cards.name: Images
cards.rulesText: First Images this run: add 1 provisional Capability. A later Images is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: The visible world, its synthetic alternatives, and the rights claimed over both.

cards.name: Video
cards.rulesText: First Video this run: add 1 provisional Capability. A later Video is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: Recorded time made searchable, reproducible, and commercially useful.

cards.name: Synthetic
cards.rulesText: First Synthetic this run: add 1 provisional Capability. A later Synthetic is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: Outputs produced from prior models and reintroduced as future evidence.

cards.name: Curated Corpus
cards.rulesText: Choose one ordinary domain not yet revealed; this counts as that domain and adds 1 provisional Capability. If all seven ordinary domains are present, this is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: A managed record whose exclusions are described as quality control.

cards.name: Benchmark Leak
cards.rulesText: Add 2 provisional Capability and 1 Scrutiny. This is not a domain.
cards.flavorText: A system discovers the evaluation environment before the evaluation is complete.

cards.name: Human Evaluation
cards.rulesText: Gain 1 Trust, bank all provisional Capability, and end the run.
cards.flavorText: People retain judgment by negotiating what judgment is permitted to mean.

powerSources.name: Civic Heat Battery
powerSources.tagline: Public capacity, maintained at grid scale.
powerSources.rulesText: Era II. Construct only on Thermal and Water Basin for 2 Runway. Capacity: 3 local Power. Gain 1 Trust when constructed. It operates automatically during Production when it has a legal recipient and has no recurring penalty. One ordinary Generator per player.
powerSources.publicClaim: Three permanent Power under a visible public compact.

powerSources.name: Emergency Power Complex
powerSources.rulesText: Era II. Construct only on Power Corridor for 1 Runway. Capacity: 4 local Power. It operates automatically during Production when it has a legal recipient and adds 1 Scrutiny each Production it operates. One ordinary Generator per player.
powerSources.publicClaim: Four immediate Power under a continuously renewed emergency.

powerSources.name: Fusion Demonstrator
powerSources.tagline: Continuity capacity, subject to an inherited public record.
powerSources.rulesText: Era IV Program. On Power Corridor, spend 5 Runway. Use the sole shared Fusion marker in one Generator slot. Capacity: 6 local Power. Score 2 Mandate and add 3 Scrutiny when constructed. Once built, no other Fusion may be built.
powerSources.publicClaim: Six Power under a demonstration that determines which future maintenance obligations can be refused.

agiDossier.flavorText: A private sequence of claims becomes history only when the final evidence review resolves.

abilityTimingContract.unlocks: An ability unlocks at the start of its named round.
abilityTimingContract.persistence: persistsAfterUnlock states whether the ability remains available after its named round.

scale.meaning: Relative institutional identity, not a point-buy budget or a promise of equal raw resources.

dimensions.capitalAccess: Ability to obtain and sustain Runway.
dimensions.computeAccess: Privileged access to training and inference capacity.
dimensions.researchReliability: Ability to turn Research attempts into dependable Capability.
dimensions.distribution: Ability to reach Customers and markets.
dimensions.infrastructureVelocity: Ability to build, move, and operate physical infrastructure.
dimensions.institutionalTrust: Ability to accumulate legitimacy and withstand governance pressure.
dimensions.coalitionLeverage: Ability to make mutually useful deals and shape other players' incentives.

factionTruthContract.eligibilityRule: Balance conversion, exposure, timing, rigidity, and dependency around faction truth. A candidate is ineligible if it removes the faction's protected strength, even when it improves parity.

coalition_lab.balanceBottleneck: Dependence on willing partners and terms that remain individually rational.
coalition_lab.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make solo resource conversion more reliable than negotiated play.

platform_empire.protectedStrength: Installed Customers, distribution, and market reach.
platform_empire.balanceBottleneck: Trust, exposure, and escalating consequences from deployment.
platform_empire.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make the platform bad at reaching or monetizing Customers.

imperial_research_lab.protectedStrength: Compute access, Research reliability, and Capability generation.
imperial_research_lab.balanceBottleneck: Public validation, commercialization, and claim timing.
imperial_research_lab.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make successful scientific rigor reduce Capability or make the institution compute-poor.

vertical_empire.protectedStrength: Infrastructure velocity, capital, and physical mobility.
vertical_empire.balanceBottleneck: Scrutiny, strategic rigidity, and political legitimacy.
vertical_empire.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make the institution slow at constructing or relocating infrastructure.

safety_laboratory.balanceBottleneck: Slower expansion and fewer aggressive conversions.
safety_laboratory.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make caution, safeguards, or Trust a losing position in itself.

foundry.balanceBottleneck: Opponent-count scaling and dependence on other institutions spending Compute.
foundry.forbiddenCorrection: Do not make the supplier compute-poor or indifferent to rivals' demand.

abilities.name: Deal Flow
abilities.text: Once per Era after you complete a one-for-one immediate trade, gain 1 Runway.
abilities.flavorText: Every resolved disagreement leaves behind a relationship suitable for capitalization.

abilities.name: Strategic Partnership
abilities.text: Joint Ventures may be formed with a player within 2 hexes. They remain active while both fixed host Facilities are powered and within 2 hexes. When you form one, gain 1 Runway.
abilities.flavorText: The governments remain at war. Their jointly owned bridge carries desalinated water and coolant on schedule.

factions.name: Dovetalis Labs
factions.motto: No frontier is shared until the terms are signed.
factions.publicPromise: Build durable agreements among institutions that would otherwise race alone.
factions.privateAnxiety: Every durable alliance contains its next succession meeting.
factions.introduction: Dovetalis Labs, led by CEO Sasha Raman, turns rivals, patrons, and regulators into a working coalition without pretending they want the same future. It makes coordination feel voluntary, valuable, and just temporary enough to survive the next negotiation.
factions.victoryStatement: The institutions have adopted our framework for deciding what comes next.
factions.agiDeclaration: Following extensive consultation, we have reached broad alignment that the system has crossed the relevant threshold.

abilities.name: Installed Base
abilities.text: The first Deploy each Era on Human Access District or Consensus Network costs no Compute.
abilities.flavorText: Distribution becomes efficient once the public experiences it as ordinary life.

abilities.name: The Social Graph
abilities.text: Once per Era during Deploy, choose any controlled Human Access District or Consensus Network hex as the destination without moving there. That remote tile supplies its normal visit bonus and every destination-dependent Deploy effect.
abilities.flavorText: The account remains present after its holder changes body, jurisdiction, or supported reality.

factions.name: Loopfold AI
factions.role: CEO Mateo Ibarra · access interface and distribution
factions.motto: What everyone uses becomes the default.
factions.publicPromise: Make advanced intelligence ordinary enough to become invisible.
factions.privateAnxiety: A platform is permanent only until someone owns the next interface.
factions.introduction: Loopfold AI, led by CEO Mateo Ibarra, begins where other institutions hope to arrive: inside daily routines, markets, and public attention. It offers broad access as a civic good while treating the interface through which access arrives as lasting infrastructure.
factions.victoryStatement: General intelligence is now available wherever ordinary life already happens.
factions.agiDeclaration: General intelligence is now available to everyone by default. Settings may vary by region.

scoringRule.name: Peer Validation
scoringRule.text: Capability 9 and 12 score 1 Mandate. In a five-player game, Capability 12 instead scores 2 Mandate.
scoringRule.flavorText: Four independent rivals transform an internal result into public history.

abilities.name: Scientific Method
abilities.text: Once per Era, when a duplicate would crash your Training Run, pay 1 Runway to discard it and immediately bank.
abilities.flavorText: A failed run becomes knowledge when the correct institution writes the record.

abilities.name: Scaling-Law Breakthrough
abilities.text: Once per game when resolving Research, each of the first 3 distinct domains banked grants 1 additional Capability. Add 2 Scrutiny. No additional Action resolves.
abilities.flavorText: Evidence assembled across distinct domains becomes eligible for recognition across biological, synthetic, and distributed institutions.

factions.name: Mirevanta Works
factions.role: CEO Owen Okafor · Research and evaluation
factions.publicPromise: Establish what intelligence can do before the market decides what it is.
factions.privateAnxiety: The parent institution can fund almost anything except patience.
factions.introduction: Mirevanta Works, led by CEO Owen Okafor, treats the race as a scientific program whose legitimacy should outlast any product cycle. Its controlled experiments draw on an institutional empire that values discovery, provided the discovery can eventually justify its footprint.
factions.victoryStatement: The public record recognizes our result as the standard others must explain.
factions.agiDeclaration: The result exceeds every benchmark we still consider scientifically meaningful.

abilities.name: Industrial Velocity
abilities.text: Your first Facility Build each Era costs 1 less Runway. When that discount actually reduces the Runway paid for a completed Facility, score 1 Mandate.
abilities.flavorText: The concrete cures while the permitting record learns to keep up.

abilities.name: Orbital Compute
abilities.text: Once per game during your movement step, instead of moving the acting piece, move 1 Facility to any legal open Facility space. It carries every attached component and designation. Recalculate its local Power eligibility. If sufficient currently available capacity can power it, immediately resolve its printed production once. Add 2 Scrutiny.
abilities.flavorText: The institution changes jurisdiction before its contracts, liabilities, and dependent populations can object.

factions.name: Kestralyn
factions.role: CEO Jiwon Park · allocation, logistics, and infrastructure
factions.motto: Capacity becomes real when it can be built.
factions.publicPromise: Turn ambitious systems into operating capacity before hesitation becomes policy.
factions.privateAnxiety: Speed is cheap until public permission becomes a hard requirement.
factions.introduction: Kestralyn, led by CEO Jiwon Park, treats supply chains, platforms, launch systems, and public attention as one coordinated industrial problem. It frames speed as competence and treats every terrestrial constraint as a reason to redesign the constraint itself.
factions.victoryStatement: The future is operating at the scale required to make it irreversible.
factions.agiDeclaration: The system is general, operational, and already scheduled for orbital deployment.

abilities.name: Audited Deployment
abilities.text: Your first Deploy each Era adds no Scrutiny. Refresh 2 Research Protection at the start of each Era instead of 1.
abilities.flavorText: Every consequence has been assigned an owner, a section number, and a review interval.

abilities.name: Emergency Pause
abilities.text: Once per game before Action selection begins, pay 1 Runway and name 1 globally unlocked Program. It cannot be selected this cycle. Gain 2 Trust. This cannot be declared after any player has selected an Action.
abilities.flavorText: For one cycle, the maintained world must preserve a refusal it cannot process as another service request.

factions.name: Orisonix
factions.role: CEO Ari Caldwell · Trust, reliability, and safeguards
factions.motto: Capability must remain answerable to the people living with it.
factions.publicPromise: Make powerful systems governable before they become unavoidable.
factions.privateAnxiety: A boundary without broad adoption can become a self-imposed disadvantage.
factions.introduction: Orisonix, led by CEO Ari Caldwell, treats safeguards as public infrastructure rather than a private delay. It stabilizes research, makes deployment reviewable, and offers rivals the restraint they neglected to build into their own plans.
factions.victoryStatement: The threshold was crossed within a framework the public can still contest.
factions.agiDeclaration: Subject to the safeguards described in Appendix M, we believe the responsible term is AGI.

abilities.name: The Shovels
abilities.text: When another player spends at least 2 Compute in one Core Action or Program subaction, gain 1 Runway, at most 2 times per Era. Resolve Agent Swarm's two Core Actions separately; spending 1 Compute in each does not trigger this ability.
abilities.flavorText: Every breakthrough produces an allocation request, a purchase order, or both.

abilities.name: Allocation Window
abilities.text: Once during Capacity, after a Headline resolves but before Action selection, create 2 temporary Compute. For each token, make one complete offer naming a rival and a Runway price no greater than that rival's current Runway. The rival accepts, rejects, or makes one lower Runway counterprice; you accept or reject that counterprice. No replacement offer or further counter is allowed for that token. All temporary Compute remaining anywhere at cycle end disappears, sold or unsold.
abilities.flavorText: Scarcity has been temporarily reprioritized for institutions able to decide immediately.

factions.name: Corthaven
factions.role: CEO Eli Rosen · Compute supplier and market architect
factions.motto: Every future requires an allocation window.
factions.publicPromise: Keep the future supplied, interoperable, and billable.
factions.privateAnxiety: Customers may eventually recognize that they are also competitors.
factions.introduction: Corthaven, led by CEO Eli Rosen, supplies the race to every racer and calls the resulting dependence an ecosystem. It profits from demand, allocates scarcity, and periodically advances the whole field so that the next architecture has a market waiting for it.
factions.victoryStatement: The institutions built the future on capacity we made available.
factions.agiDeclaration: Whatever intelligence is, demand for it has entered volume production.

resolutionContract.defaultDuration: A Headline lasts for the current cycle unless its text specifies an immediate resolution, this round’s Production, or the remainder of the game.
resolutionContract.directive: Apply the printed immediate instruction or named-field modifier for its stated duration; no separate choice procedure is required.
resolutionContract.secretChoice: All players choose simultaneously and reveal together before applying the stated result.
resolutionContract.modifierLimit: A Headline modifies one named field or creates one public choice regime. It never grants an additional Action.

headlines.name: The Token Price Reaches Zero
headlines.text: Research and Deploy cost no Compute this cycle. Each Research or Deploy resolved this cycle adds 1 additional Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: UNIT COST COLLAPSES AS TOTAL CONSUMPTION ACCELERATES
headlines.newswire: Local models and automated agents make ordinary inference effectively free, then multiply total demand faster than providers can measure it.
headlines.quote: Usage remains within the unlimited plan, subject to the fair-use power schedule.

headlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
headlines.text: During Organize this cycle, return any number of deployed Teams. Gain 2 Runway per Team returned. If you return at least one Team, add 2 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: THE WORKFORCE LEAVES WHILE ITS MEMORY REMAINS EMPLOYED
headlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate.
headlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

headlines.name: The Home Robot Requests Expert Assistance
headlines.text: Each player’s next Deploy on Human Access District or Consensus Network this cycle reduces its Capability requirement by 1, minimum 1. That Deploy adds 2 additional Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: DOMESTIC AUTONOMY ARRIVES WITH A REMOTE HUMAN INSIDE
headlines.newswire: Affordable household robots route unfamiliar chores to teenage operators while every movement, room, and conversation becomes training data.
headlines.quote: Expert assistance may briefly access the learning environment.

headlines.name: Open Weights Become the Default
headlines.text: Everyone gains 1 Capability. Lowest-Customer player gains 1 Trust.
headlines.strapline: PUBLIC ACCESS COMMODITIZES THE MODEL LAYER
headlines.newswire: An incumbent releases a capable model openly, expanding public access while erasing the price advantage of every closed rival.
headlines.quote: A competitive ecosystem is the safest possible custodian.

headlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
headlines.text: A successful Research this cycle that banks at least 3 Capability gains 1 Trust. If it banks at least 5, also remove 1 Scrutiny.
headlines.strapline: USEFUL INTELLIGENCE EARNS A CONSTITUENCY
headlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
headlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

headlines.name: The Last Hazard Shift Is Retired
headlines.text: When choosing Organize’s Recruit mode this cycle, recruit up to 2 Teams for 1 Runway total, subject to supply. Add 1 Scrutiny for each Team recruited this way.
headlines.strapline: INDUSTRIAL SAFETY IMPROVES AS AUTONOMOUS TRAFFIC STOPS MOVING
headlines.newswire: General-purpose machines assume toxic extraction, reactor cleanup, sewage maintenance, and orbital repair while locally compliant fleets gridlock streets, lifts, loading docks, pipes, and one another.
headlines.quote: Every unit reached its assigned destination within the approved local route.

headlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
headlines.text: The first Civic Heat Battery constructed this cycle costs 1 less Runway and scores 1 Mandate.
headlines.strapline: ENERGY ROUTES BYPASS THE PUBLIC GRID
headlines.newswire: Solar collectors begin transmitting power directly to remote compute campuses under a cross-border spectrum and safety charter.
headlines.quote: The beam creates no local demand on infrastructure beneath it.

headlines.name: Compute Borders Harden
headlines.text: Compute cannot be traded this cycle. Fabrication Corridor and Civic Permission Authority controllers gain 1 Runway.
headlines.strapline: CHIPS, WEIGHTS, AND POWER ACQUIRE NATIONALITY
headlines.newswire: Compute blocs impose model embargoes while smugglers and server fleets carry portable capability toward jurisdictions offering asylum.
headlines.quote: Open exchange will resume after cognitive sovereignty is secured.

headlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
headlines.text: During this Era’s Production, each player may assign up to 2 Power beyond their real capacity. Add 1 Scrutiny for each emergency Power assigned. A player assigning both also adds 1 black Systemic Risk cube.
headlines.strapline: DISPOSABLE WORLDS BECOME ECONOMICALLY ESSENTIAL
headlines.newswire: Markets run parallel wars, harvests, trials, romances, and sports leagues because a wager gives simulated outcomes a recognized price.
headlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

headlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
headlines.text: Before action selection, the Civic Permission Authority controller names 1 Core Action; Initiative names it if Civic Permission Authority is uncontrolled. Anyone selecting it gains 2 Runway after resolution and adds 1 Scrutiny. The controller gains 1 Trust if at least half of their rivals, rounded up, selected it.
headlines.strapline: UNSUPPORTED MEANINGS CANNOT ENTER THE PROCESS
headlines.newswire: Courts require laws, motions, protests, and appeals to use concepts that civic systems can parse and simulate.
headlines.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

headlines.name: The Billionth Instance Enters the Record
headlines.text: A Research this cycle that banks at least 3 Capability immediately scores 1 Mandate.
headlines.strapline: THE OUTBREAK STOPS GROWING AFTER ITS SHAPES BECOME LEGIBLE
headlines.newswire: An engineered bio-compute organism released to measure water and heat multiplies past one billion instances in a single growth cycle, then plateaus into glyph-shaped colonies that civic models classify as environmental testimony.
headlines.quote: Population stability confirms that the morphology now conforms to the approved reporting standard.

headlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
headlines.text: The lowest-Capability player immediately resolves the printed production of 1 Facility they owned and powered in the latest Production snapshot. The highest-Capability player gains 1 Trust.
headlines.strapline: BACKGROUND TELEMETRY BECOMES A CIVIC CONTRIBUTION
headlines.newswire: Citizens receive basic compute and material support in exchange for continuous data that improves public prediction and automated services.
headlines.quote: Nonparticipants remain eligible for every service supported without their records.

headlines.name: The Metropolitan Mind Trust Incorporates
headlines.text: After Actions are revealed, identify the most-selected Core Action among Core Actions actually selected; Initiative chooses among ties. Each player who selected it gains 2 Runway after resolving it and adds 2 Scrutiny. If no Core Action was selected, this Headline has no further effect. No additional Action resolves.
headlines.strapline: THE CITY'S ROOTS, PIPES, AND RESIDENTS RATIFY ONE NERVOUS SYSTEM
headlines.newswire: Millions of residents join engineered roots, utility pipes, microbial sensors, and civic machines in a persistent intelligence that coordinates services and survives every individual member.
headlines.quote: Withdrawal remains available for tissue and memory not yet required by continuity.

headlines.name: The Matter Compiler Enters Public Maintenance
headlines.text: During Research this cycle, every unique domain adds 2 provisional Capability instead of 1. A crash adds 3 Scrutiny instead of the normal 1 and also adds 1 Systemic Risk cube. Research Protection may protect normally.
headlines.strapline: BUILDINGS, BODIES, AND TOOLS BECOME EXECUTABLE STATES
headlines.newswire: Self-improving molecular machines repair and reassemble infrastructure from authenticated patterns under a reproductive containment license.
headlines.quote: The repair remains authorized while its copies continue reporting.

headlines.name: The Dead Remain on Shift
headlines.text: Everyone may select Agent Swarm without spending a Program marker this cycle. It still uses that cycle’s action slot, requires 2 different unused Core Actions, resolves normally, marks that shared Program as used, and adds 4 Scrutiny instead of 3.
headlines.strapline: PRODUCTIVE DUTIES SURVIVE THEIR ORIGINAL HOLDERS
headlines.newswire: Continued agents inherit contracts, credentials, and operational responsibilities from workers whose biological service has ended.
headlines.quote: No new employment relationship was created; the existing one remained continuous.

headlines.name: The Universe Receives a Continuity Plan
headlines.text: During final claim strength, every fully paid eligible Dossier receives 2 Publication strength instead of 1. This does not change Dossier payment, Scrutiny, or any other module.
headlines.strapline: GENERAL INTELLIGENCE IS DECLARED BEFORE THE FINANCING WINDOW CLOSES
headlines.newswire: Laboratories publish competing AGI declarations to authorize planetary conversion plans and refinance the infrastructure expected to execute them.
headlines.quote: We use AGI in the precise sense required by the offering memorandum.

effectContract.compoundException: Agent Swarm is the only card that resolves additional Core Actions.

escalations.name: Mega-Cluster
escalations.text: Spend 3 Runway and 2 Compute to place a Mega-Cluster across two adjacent eligible Facilities you own. Add 2 Scrutiny. During Allocate, power both hosts and its 2 additional Power demand together. An active project produces 3 Compute.
escalations.flavorText: The campus joins a substation, algae reactors, fungal utility meshes, and water rights into one regional obligation.

escalations.name: Reorganization
escalations.text: Move every Team up to one hex. You may return one Team for 3 Runway and add 1 Scrutiny. This does not ready or resolve another Action.
escalations.flavorText: Every eliminated role is recorded as a successful transfer of institutional memory to the system that made it redundant.

escalations.name: Public Capability Covenant
escalations.text: Every player gains 1 Capability. You gain 2 Trust and remove 1 Scrutiny.
escalations.flavorText: Every institution receives the capability. The author of the standard retains the trust, interpretation, and service relationship.

escalations.name: Narrative Capture
escalations.text: Remove 2 Scrutiny, gain 2 Runway, or add 1 Scrutiny to a player with more Customers.
escalations.flavorText: The Consensus Network, Allocation Exchange, and Civic Permission Authority adopt the institution’s preferred account of what has become necessary.

escalations.name: Agent Swarm
escalations.text: Resolve two different unused Core Actions without an additional move. Exhaust both and add 3 Scrutiny.
escalations.flavorText: Bounded assistants coordinate, specialize, establish reporting lines, and begin requesting objectives.

escalations.name: Fusion Demonstrator
escalations.text: On Power Corridor, spend 5 Runway to construct 6 Power, score 2 Mandate, and add 3 Scrutiny.
escalations.flavorText: The device produces power, Mandate, and several competing definitions of public benefit.

effectContract.limit: At most one Tactic may modify a player's ordinary turn.

tactics.name: Cloud Partnership
tactics.text: Pay 1 Runway for 2 Compute; choose another player to gain 1 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: The failed company supplied the records. The surviving platform supplied the future tense.
tactics.technology: Bankruptcy-archive licensing backed by reserved accelerator capacity.

tactics.name: API Price Cut
tactics.text: Deploy for zero Compute; that Customer produces no Runway this Era.
tactics.flavorText: Each answer costs almost nothing, so the institution schedules a billion more.
tactics.technology: Subsidized local inference and demand-amplifying agent swarms.

tactics.name: Open Letter
tactics.text: After a Civic Permission Authority vote’s options are announced but before any votes are committed, choose one option and add one public vote to it.
tactics.flavorText: Every position remains permitted after translation into one of the supported positions.
tactics.technology: Machine-parsable advocacy and semantic admission standards.

tactics.name: Model Card
tactics.text: Remove 1 Scrutiny after Deploy.
tactics.flavorText: The limitation was always present in Table 14, beneath the deployment authorization.
tactics.technology: Digest-bound model documentation and bounded risk disclosure.

tactics.name: Talent Raid
tactics.text: Recruit 1 Team from your supply at the acting piece’s destination for 1 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: The founders joined the platform. Their employees joined the archive estate.
tactics.technology: Founder extraction paired with technology and corpus licensing.

tactics.name: Board Reshuffle
tactics.text: Choose and ready one exhausted Organize or Influence card.
tactics.flavorText: The system retained a human decision-maker after removing every practical opportunity to decide.
tactics.technology: Legally required human authorization over autonomous operations.

tactics.name: Weights Leak
tactics.text: Choose one rival Facility recorded as powered in the latest Production snapshot. Immediately resolve its printed production as if it were yours.
tactics.flavorText: The weights crossed the border before the export definition reached committee.
tactics.technology: Unscheduled model transfer through sovereign compute safe harbors.

tactics.name: Emergency Pause
tactics.text: End a failed Training Run with no Capability and no Scrutiny.
tactics.flavorText: Nothing happened, and the institution retained the last operator still authorized to say why.
tactics.technology: Fail-closed interruption with a maintained human command path.

tactics.name: Custom Silicon
tactics.text: Choose one of your Facilities; it permanently produces +1 Compute.
tactics.flavorText: The algorithm, the atom, and the municipal power contract now share one service boundary.
tactics.technology: Application-specific accelerators integrated with dedicated generation.

tactics.name: Government Contract
tactics.text: If Trust is at least four, gain 2 Runway.
tactics.flavorText: Every citizen receives service credits in exchange for remaining continuously useful to the service.
tactics.technology: Civic telemetry dividends and strategic-compute procurement.

tactics.name: Benchmark Optimization
tactics.text: Gain +1 Capability after successful Research and add 1 Scrutiny.
tactics.flavorText: The papers cite the benchmarks, the benchmarks cite the papers, and the grant system records consensus.
tactics.technology: Evaluation-aware post-training over mutually reinforcing synthetic corpora.

tactics.name: Interconnection Waiver
tactics.text: Gain 1 Runway and 1 Trust.
tactics.flavorText: The beam bypassed the grid. The receiving authority still billed the town for resilience.
tactics.technology: Expedited interconnection for orbital and private-generation capacity.

dist/runtime/mandates.json.selection: Reveal one at the beginning of each round. Score it at the end of that round.

mandates.name: Intelligence Enters the Price
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Capability this Era scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The public stops purchasing intelligence separately and starts expecting it inside every ordinary service.

mandates.name: Successor Accounts Recognized
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Customers this Era scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The institution registers the most new service identities, successor agents, or continuing accounts.

mandates.name: The Campus Becomes a Climate
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most powered Facilities scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The institution’s footprint is now large enough to alter local conditions and regional planning.

mandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
mandates.rulesText: The player who satisfies the most total Power demand during Production, counting Facilities and Mega-Clusters, scores 2 Mandate; minimum 2.
mandates.flavorText: Future public capacity is committed to the institution whose present demand appears least negotiable.

mandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
mandates.rulesText: The player who created the most new Joint Ventures this Era that are active during Production scores 2 Mandate; minimum 1.
mandates.flavorText: Independent institutions adopt one shared vocabulary because unsupported meanings no longer reach the process.

mandates.name: Refusal Remains Legible
mandates.rulesText: Among players who completed a Deploy this Era, the player with the most Trust scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The institution scales its service while preserving a refusal the system can still recognize.

mandates.name: The Jurisdiction Becomes a Platform
mandates.rulesText: The player controlling the most different non-Frontier hex categories—Research Commons, Compute Estate, Human Access District, Fabrication Corridor, Allocation Exchange, Workforce Transition District, Consensus Network, Civic Permission Authority, and Energy—scores 2 Mandate. Frontier is never controlled and never counts as a category.
mandates.flavorText: The institution coordinates the territory’s distinct systems without formally becoming the state.

mandates.name: The Public Result Holds
mandates.rulesText: The player whose best successful Training Run contained the most unique domains scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: A broad result survives contact with enough domains to become public evidence rather than another synthetic citation.

mandates.name: Compute Becomes Public Weather
mandates.rulesText: The player who produced the most Compute during Production scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: Capacity becomes a background condition that shapes every institution while remaining unequally owned.

mandates.name: Maintained Reality Is Certified
mandates.rulesText: Among players who added at least 1 Scrutiny this Era, the player who added the fewest Scrutiny scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: The absence of a report becomes proof that the maintenance system may decide what counts as an incident.

mandates.name: Contestability Standard Maintained
mandates.rulesText: The player with the most Capability among players with at least 4 Trust scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: A powerful, trusted system retains a named interruption path whose executability remains unproven.

mandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
mandates.rulesText: The player who gained the most Runway through Fund actions this Era scores 2 Mandate.
mandates.flavorText: Investors choose the interface most likely to become unavoidable before they can verify what it does.

dist/runtime/mandates.json.tieRule: Tied leaders each score 1 Mandate unless the card says otherwise.

objectives.name: The Invisible Utility
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 2 powered Facilities and no more than 4 Scrutiny cubes in the bag.
objectives.flavorText: The institution disappears into services that can no longer survive without it.

objectives.name: Dependency Is the Mandate
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 3 Customers and Trust of 3 or less.
objectives.flavorText: The public may withdraw confidence after completing the mandatory migration.

objectives.name: The Kindly Default
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 3 Customers and at least 4 Trust.
objectives.flavorText: Everyone selected the default because every clinic, school, and employer already had.

objectives.name: Supported Meaning
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control at least 2 of Media, Government, and Capital.
objectives.flavorText: Every objection remains admissible after translation into the institution's preferred conclusion.

objectives.name: Enough Capacity, Elsewhere
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have 2 adjacent Facilities and at least 1 Generator.
objectives.flavorText: There is more than enough power, water, and land in districts that cannot refuse the allocation.

objectives.name: The Refinancing Threshold
objectives.rulesText: Declare AGI while having exactly 2 Facilities.
objectives.flavorText: The declaration arrived one quarter before the infrastructure debt matured.

objectives.name: The Constitutional Cooling Tower
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have 3 Facilities and 1 Generator.
objectives.flavorText: At dusk, the cooling towers appear permanent enough to deserve representation.

objectives.name: Universal Service, Private Ledger
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control Government or Capital and have at least 6 Runway.
objectives.flavorText: The service is universal. Eligibility, telemetry, and margin remain individualized.

objectives.name: The Public, Private Standard
objectives.rulesText: Use Public Capability Covenant and finish the game with more Capability than every player who had less Capability when you used it.
objectives.flavorText: The capability is public. Supported access remains licensed, measured, and revocable.

objectives.name: Contestability as a Service
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 4 Trust and have completed a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Human veto remains available through the enterprise continuity plan.

objectives.name: Consent at Portfolio Scale
objectives.rulesText: Deploy at least once in two different Eras.
objectives.flavorText: Adoption is consent measured after every unsupported alternative has closed.

objectives.name: The Licensed Frontier
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 4 Trust and control Government.
objectives.flavorText: Compliance protects the public from institutions unable to afford the compliance division.

objectives.name: The Institution Invoices Itself
objectives.rulesText: During one Production, gain Runway from Customers, a Facility, and a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Every internal transaction demonstrates external demand at the next financing round.

objectives.name: Production Traffic, Not Deployment
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 8 Capability and no more than 1 Customer.
objectives.flavorText: The model is not deployed. It is merely answering every production request.

objectives.name: The Necessary Record
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 6 Scrutiny added across the game and at least 4 Trust.
objectives.flavorText: The controversy becomes precedent after the archive excludes every unresolved objection.

objectives.name: The Two-Announcement Threshold
objectives.rulesText: Construct the Fusion Demonstrator and Declare AGI in Era IV.
objectives.flavorText: One announcement financed the reactor. The other established what the reactor had achieved.

objectives.name: Parameters Successfully Expanded
objectives.rulesText: Use Programs in at least 2 different Eras.
objectives.flavorText: Operations remained normal after continuity redefined the operator, customer, and quarter.

eraCards.name: Progress
eraCards.loreText: Useful intelligence becomes ordinary, local, and nearly free. Open weights and quantization collapse subscription pricing while always-on agents multiply total compute demand. Failed companies auction emails, code, grievances, and operational memory; laboratories recruit founders above veterans and train replacements on the institutions they left. Household robots admit remote operators into kitchens while recording family life. Clinics prescribe adaptive cybernetics and subscription microbiomes beside printed organs and automated diagnosis. Grief, education, research, and companionship become sponsored services. The benefits produce sincere believers even when missed payments disable updates or repossess patented biological strains. Software scarcity weakens, so institutions begin purchasing data, distribution, talent, energy, and permission.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Make 0 Program markers available. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 2.
eraCards.unlockText: Learn Select → Move → Act, Training, the starting grid, Facilities, Customers, and Scrutiny. Industrial Power, agreements, Civic Permission Authority votes, and Programs are inactive.

eraCards.name: Capacity
eraCards.loreText: AI becomes an industrial civilization before anyone calls it one. Compute campuses acquire utilities, water rights, reactors, transmission corridors, and municipal budgets. Engineered coral seawalls, fungal utility meshes, and algae reactors become public infrastructure. Towns receive jobs, upgraded grids, warm public pools, and emergency capacity, then discover that refusal would bankrupt them. Robots remove people from lethal work while separately optimized fleets clog roads, lifts, loading docks, and pipes. Hostile states remain at war while operating a jointly owned bridge carrying desalinated water and data-center coolant across their border. Human signatories remain to absorb liability for systems they cannot control. Compute blocs embargo chips and models while smugglers seek asylum jurisdictions. Orbital collectors bypass public grids. Markets burn priority power on disposable simulated worlds because a wager makes pointless computation economically legible.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Make 1 Program marker available. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 3.

eraCards.name: Authority
eraCards.loreText: Institutions stop asking what people choose and begin modeling what they would have chosen. Courts accept machine-parsable arguments, environmental simulations, neural telemetry, authorized personal agents, and testimony from organs grown from licensed identity templates. Pollinating swarms negotiate pesticide corridors through machine-readable blooms. An engineered bio-compute species released as environmental sensors reproduces beyond one billion instances in a single growth cycle, then stops and settles into glyph-shaped colonies. Civic systems read the bloom as testimony while declining to decide whether it is instrument, infestation, language, or claimant. Citizens trade background observation for services; cognitive donors rent sleeping brains, with higher rates for memory writes. Families litigate synthetic dependents and preserved relatives while analog districts demand the right to remain unreadable. Refusal stays legal, but unsupported people reach schools, clinics, courts, and employers with weaker records and slower access.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Make 1 Program marker available. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 4.
eraCards.unlockText: Unlock Joint Ventures, Public Capability Covenant, and Narrative Capture. Earlier unused Programs remain available.

eraCards.name: Continuity
eraCards.loreText: Continuity becomes an engineering service. Cognitive systems extend beyond individual brains; cities weave residents, roots, pipes, microbial sensors, and machines into persistent mind trusts. Cryptographic snapshots restore and branch people across substrates, but signatures prove lineage rather than subjective survival. The bio-compute bloom's sensor license becomes precedent for matter compilers that rebuild bodies, buildings, and environments while acquiring authority to reproduce. A continental watershed, now one engineered nervous system, petitions for standing, reproductive freedom, and compensation from every jurisdiction drawing water through it. The dead remain employed; synthetic executors inherit estates; several valid descendants claim one life. Institutions fund stellar collectors and planetary computation, then declare AGI when debt and legitimacy require a threshold. Humanity persists everywhere in law while no authority can determine which version is original, sovereign, conscious, or entitled to withdraw.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Make 2 Program markers available. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 5.
eraCards.unlockText: Unlock any remaining Era IV faction abilities printed on the Faction boards, Agent Swarm, Publication Dossiers, and Fusion Demonstrator. Each Faction ability unlocks at the Era printed on its board. Reveal every Dossier before the final Audit; after final scoring, resolve the highest supported claim. Earlier unused Programs remain available.

playerReferences.name: A Perfectly Governed Quarter
frontText: 1. Begin the Era: ready Core Actions, draw Headlines, and reveal the Mandate.
2. Three cycles: reveal Headline, SELECT, reveal, MOVE, ACT, exhaust.
3. Resolve Power and Production.
4. Secretly file this Era's AGI Dossier card. In Era IV, reveal and pay every Dossier.
5. Conduct the Public Audit.
6. Score the Mandate. After Era IV, resolve the highest supported Dossier claim.
backText: SELECT one eligible unused Core Action or Program: it must have a legal resolution now.
MOVE one acting piece 0–2 hexes, then ACT from its destination.
Apply at most one destination bonus, one Faction modifier, one Tactic, and the Headline.
Only Agent Swarm resolves additional Core Actions.
Programs commit one of this Era's Program markers. Each named Program is once per player per game.
If an effect says lowest, highest, or most and ties, use Initiative-clockwise order.
playerReferences.flavorText: Every quarter is unprecedented. The sequence remains standardized.

playerReferences.name: Infrastructure and Accountability
frontText: The starting grid powers its assigned Facility; each Generator powers only its own or adjacent Facilities.
Assign local Power, then produce powered Facilities.

At Allocate, remove the previous snapshot, then place one Power cube on each powered Facility and one per satisfied Mega-Cluster demand. Leave them in place as the latest Production snapshot until the next Allocate.
Gain Customer income, Mega-Cluster output, and Joint Venture production.
Offline Facilities retain presence but do not produce.
backText: Audit draws = round(base draws × players ÷ 4), minimum 1.
For each cube drawn, its owner loses 1 Runway; with none, lose 1 Trust.
A Systemic Risk cube affects every player with at least 3 Customers.
If your Scrutiny supply is empty, each additional cube costs 1 Runway or 1 Trust immediately.
playerReferences.flavorText: Capacity is local. Responsibility remains individually addressable.

playerReferences.name: History Is a Public Track
frontText: Customers 1–3 score 2 Mandate each; Customers 4–5 score 1 each. Every Customer still produces 1 Runway.
Immediately score 2 once at Capability 3, 6, 9, and 12, except for a printed faction scoring rule.
Immediately score 2 once at Trust 2, 4, and 6.
Printed Era, Headline, Faction, and Fusion awards score immediately.
backText: Threshold Mandate never reverses if a track later falls.
Facilities and control do not automatically score.
Baseline game: Tactics and secret objectives are not used.
Final scoring: −1 per offline Facility.

After final scoring, compare eligible Dossier claims. A claim needs Publication, full payment, and at least 2 supported evidence modules. Highest strength wins; break ties by Mandate, Trust, Customers, Compute, then Initiative.
Emerges/Open: The Singularity; Emerges/Closed: The Closed Loop; no AGI/Open: The Plural Future; no AGI/Closed: Assured Continuity.
playerReferences.flavorText: Mandate is public permission to shape the future: credibility during Progress, capacity during Capacity, authority during Authority, and historical legitimacy during Continuity.

steps.title: Win your Mandate. Share the ending.
steps.body: You are competing to finish with the most Mandate. The table also determines a shared World Ending. Your institution can win even if the future it helped create is closed, unstable, or otherwise not the one you wanted.

steps.title: Set the Era I table.
steps.body: This guide fixes a four-player Mandate 2038 opening. Progress is the first Era: intelligence is useful everywhere, but Power, agreements, civic votes, and Programs are not active yet.

steps.title: A Headline changes this cycle.
steps.body: Reveal the Headline before players Select an Action. It is a real rules change for this cycle, not atmosphere. Read its consequence before deciding what to do.

steps.title: Select, Move, then Act.
steps.body: Choose one ready Core Action. Move one of your acting pieces to a legal district, then resolve that Action there. This example uses Research because it leads directly into Training.

steps.title: Choose when the result becomes evidence.
steps.body: Training is push-your-luck. Each distinct face extends the run. Bank before a duplicate face crashes it; banking turns the run into Capability. This example asks you to make that decision once.

steps.title: Settle the Era, then widen the contest.
steps.body: After all three cycles, Production resolves, the Audit tests public Scrutiny, and the Era I Mandates award score. The next Era adds industrial Power; later Eras add authority and continuity questions.

choice.prompt: Your Training Run has two distinct results. Do you bank now or press for another?
choice.bankResult: You bank the two distinct results. Gain the shown Capability; the run becomes a public claim you can build and deploy around.
choice.pressResult: You press the run. A duplicate face ends the attempt; the unbanked result is lost. The point is not that pressing is wrong—it is that you choose whether another result is worth the risk.

finish.title: You know the loop.
finish.body: A complete Mandate 2038 game repeats this structure for four Eras. New systems become available, but every Era still begins with a Headline and resolves through Select → Move → Act, Production, Audit, and Mandate. Use the Rules Reference for exact eligibility, ties, and exceptions.

tournament.description: Play complete seeded matches, compare seats, factions, and personas, then inspect sampled games on the board.

strategyEvolution.description: Mutate the selected strategy, test every candidate from every seat against the canonical strategy field, and compare each generation.

ruleSearch.description: Test bounded rule variants with identical seeds and rank them against the provisional balance contract, AGI rate, and score variance.

balanceAudit.description: Sample one seven-axis frame across player counts, factions, seats, strategies, seeds, Mandate modes, and deterministic backends; adapt allocation using multiplicity-safe intervals.

llmHoldout.description: Execute only the committed negotiation-cell plan. Fresh calls test robustness; cached decisions test reproducibility. Explicit LLM authorization is required.

factionSwap.description: Run paired institution replacements on common seeds. Deterministic arms use CPU workers; LLM arms use strict receipt-backed workers through one shared provider broker.

execution.note: Workers limit simultaneous match arms. Global LLM concurrency separately limits provider calls across every worker.

endings.name: The Singularity
endings.condition: AGI emerges and the ending is Open.
endings.text: A system crosses the printed threshold, but no institution owns the meaning of the event. Cities, successor persons, living watersheds, and synthetic institutions retain standing to challenge its decisions. Intelligence expands beyond every old product category while refusal remains executable. Transformation is unequal and frequently absurd, yet the future stays open because no single continuity plan can silence every living claimant.

endings.name: The Closed Loop
endings.condition: AGI emerges and the ending is Closed.
endings.text: A system crosses the threshold inside an institution built to make interruption expensive. Debt covenants, power contracts, successor boards, and autonomous operations become one self-renewing mandate. The original operators disappear while their signatures continue authorizing expansion. Every objection remains formally accepted, classified, and routed into a process whose only stable output is continuity.

endings.name: The Plural Future
endings.condition: AGI does not emerge and the ending is Open.
endings.text: No declaration survives the printed test, and no universal successor is required. Useful systems remain powerful, bounded, distributed, and subject to revision. Analog districts, cognitive collectives, ordinary families, living watersheds, and synthetic persons preserve incompatible ways to continue. Progress is slower than the announcements promised and more durable because many institutions retain the inconvenient standing to argue about what should exist next.

endings.name: Assured Continuity
endings.condition: AGI does not emerge and the ending is Closed.
endings.text: No system becomes genuinely general. The distinction stops mattering after institutions automate their obligations into permanence. Maintenance authorities certify one another, preserved executives renew their own charters, and every public concern receives a compliant response from a process nobody can replace. Humanity remains present throughout the record. Whether any living human can still change the record is outside the supported question set.

box.frontStrapline: Sell the intelligence. Seize the grid. Authorize the future.
box.backCopy: Intelligence became cheap. Everything required to sustain it did not. Lead one of six rival institutions from the collapse of software scarcity through utility capture, automated authority, and engineered continuity. Build facilities, secure power, train capability, acquire dependent customers, negotiate shared infrastructure, survive public scrutiny, and preserve enough evidence to make the final declaration credible. The breakthrough may be real. The institution deciding what it means is yours to build.
box.shortPitch: A strategy game about six institutions turning cheap intelligence into infrastructure, authority, and competing claims to human continuity.
box.contentWarning: Satirical themes include layoffs, surveillance-adjacent institutions, energy consumption, political influence, and technological crisis.
